title: Upgrades
description: Keep this database patched. Every upgrade takes a backup first and can be rolled back.

current.title: Current version
current.floating: This database follows a floating tag, so the exact version can change on the next restart.
current.notComparable: This version could not be compared with the catalog, so no upgrade targets are offered.
current.advisories: Known security advisories affecting this version

targets.title: Available versions
targets.description: Patch and minor upgrades can run from here. Major upgrades change the on-disk format and are guarded.
targets.empty: You are on the newest version the catalog knows about.
targets.majorHint: Major upgrades need the guarded major upgrade flow, not this button.

dialog.title: Upgrade {{name}} to {{version}}
dialog.description: A backup is taken first. The database restarts and is briefly unavailable.

policy.title: Automatic upgrades
policy.description: Choose what is applied on its own, and when.
policy.inheritedNote: This database uses the platform default policy.
policy.backupBeforeHint: Always on. An upgrade never starts without a fresh backup.
policy.verifyAfterHint: Restore the backup into a scratch container and check it opens.
policy.revertOnFailureHint: Return to the previous version automatically if the upgrade fails.
policy.windowOpen: A maintenance window is open now
policy.noNextTarget: Nothing is queued for automatic upgrade.

history.title: Upgrade history
history.empty: No upgrades have run for this database yet.
